title: The 2000s Metal Quiz
subtitle: Four rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Rewritten for the Bronze starter set on 20 August 2026 — a second round added. Read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which band released the 2001 album 'Iowa', their first UK number one?
questions.answerNote: It was named after the band's home state.

questions.prompt: Which band's 2000 debut 'Hybrid Theory' became one of the best-selling debut albums of all time?
questions.answerNote: It has sold more than twenty million copies worldwide.

questions.prompt: Which Californian band released 'Toxicity' in 2001?
questions.answerNote: It went to number one in America the week before 11 September 2001.

questions.prompt: Which band released the 2003 album 'St. Anger'?
questions.answerNote: Its snare drum sound is one of the most argued-about in metal.

questions.prompt: Which band's 2000 debut 'The Sickness' contained 'Down with the Sickness'?
questions.answerNote: The Chicago band have since had five consecutive US number one albums.

questions.prompt: Which band's 2004 album 'Leviathan' was built around Moby-Dick?
questions.answerNote: The Atlanta band's sleeve art was by Paul Romano.

questions.prompt: Which band released 'City of Evil' in 2005?
questions.answerNote: It was the album on which M. Shadows dropped screamed vocals for clean singing.

questions.prompt: Which Welsh band released their debut album 'The Poison' in 2005?
questions.answerNote: The band formed in Bridgend in 1998.

questions.prompt: Which Massachusetts band released 'The End of Heartache' in 2004?
questions.answerNote: It was their first album with Howard Jones on vocals.

questions.prompt: Which Virginia band released 'Ashes of the Wake' in 2004?
questions.answerNote: Randy Blythe's band had previously recorded as Burn the Priest.

questions.prompt: Besides Slipknot, which band does Corey Taylor front?
questions.answerNote: Stone Sour actually predates Slipknot, forming in 1992.

questions.prompt: Which band did Chris Cornell front in the 1990s, before Audioslave?
questions.answerNote: Audioslave paired him with three quarters of Rage Against the Machine.

questions.prompt: How many members did Slipknot have through their 2000s masked line-up?
questions.answerNote: Each wore a numbered boiler suit as well as a mask.

questions.prompt: Which Slipknot bassist died in 2010?
questions.answerNote: He was a founder member and wrote much of the band's early material.

questions.prompt: Which festival began at Donington Park in 2003, taking over from Monsters of Rock?
questions.answerNote: Iron Maiden and Audioslave headlined the first one.

questions.prompt: Which side project did Linkin Park's Mike Shinoda form, releasing 'The Rising Tied' in 2005?
questions.answerNote: It leaned on hip hop rather than rock.

questions.prompt: Which former Pantera guitarist was shot dead on stage in 2004?
questions.answerNote: He was playing with his later band Damageplan in Columbus, Ohio.

questions.prompt: Which band's 2001 album 'Break the Cycle' contained 'It's Been Awhile'?
questions.answerNote: Aaron Lewis's band were signed after Fred Durst saw them live.

questions.prompt: Which vocalist fronted Linkin Park alongside Mike Shinoda?
questions.answerNote: He joined in 1999 after auditioning down the phone.

questions.prompt: Which touring festival, founded by Ozzy and Sharon Osbourne, ran through the 2000s?
questions.answerNote: Black Sabbath headlined several of them.

rounds.title: Round Four — Pick Them All
rounds.blurb: More than one answer is right. Lock in every one of them.

questions.prompt: Which of these are genuine nu-metal/rap-metal acts?
questions.answerNote: Metallica are thrash metal; Iron Maiden are NWOBHM, both far older scenes.

questions.prompt: Which of these bands has Chester Bennington actually fronted?
questions.answerNote: Bennington fronted Stone Temple Pilots from 2013 to 2015, alongside his own Linkin Park.

questions.prompt: Which of these bands are British rather than American?
questions.answerNote: Bullet For My Valentine and Feeder are Welsh; Muse are from Devon.

questions.prompt: Which of these are genuine Linkin Park albums?
questions.answerNote: Toxicity is System of a Down, Significant Other is Limp Bizkit, Vol. 3 is Slipknot.
